name: rapidkit-vscode
description: The AI workspace for backend teams. Build backend systems with AI that knows your workspace, generate projects and modules from intent, debug with full context, and ship faster — all inside VS Code. FastAPI, NestJS, Spring Boot, Go/Fiber & Go/Gin.

scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run esbuild-base -- --production && cd webview-ui && npm run build
scripts.compile: npm run clean:dist && tsc -p ./ && npm run webview:build
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:ai-reliability: vitest run src/test/aiReliabilityGate.test.ts src/test/aiService.test.ts src/test/aiContextResolver.test.ts src/test/chatParticipant.test.ts src/test/driftGuard.test.ts src/test/incidentStudioPolicyGates.test.ts src/test/incidentStudioResponseValidator.test.ts src/test/incidentStudioTelemetry.test.ts
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
